name: CrowdStrike FAMOUS CHOLLIMA 2025 infiltration scale

attribution.legal_posture: Security-vendor research finding; legal identity and adjudication remain outside the finding.

caveats: CrowdStrike phrases real-time deepfake use as reported; the subclaim remains at that source wording.
The public post leaves the companies and precise confirmation threshold for each infiltration unspecified.

statements: CrowdStrike reported that FAMOUS CHOLLIMA infiltrated more than 320 companies during the preceding 12 months, a 220% year-over-year increase.

CrowdStrike said the cluster used GenAI at every hiring/employment stage: generating attractive resumes, reportedly masking identities with real-time deepfakes in video interviews, and using AI coding tools to perform work.
